title: The second advisor at Bonny Oaks, alone at the counter: the price before the need, and the first 'not today' accepted
demonstrates: Slot 17 in writing, on one of the lead advisor's days off: 'gotcha', the price before what the part does, 'just holler' at the first no. The draft he wrote over asked for the booking. A second question waits an hour, and then he edits the draft into an answer of his own. He does not resolve.

customer.name: Dwight Hensley
customer.note: a customer of the Bonny Oaks shop; 2013 Ford F-150; front sway bar links recommended at yesterday's oil change

scenario.who_writes: A customer reading yesterday's inspection sheet.
scenario.what_happens: 'What's that clunk thing': the price first, then what it is. 'Not today': accepted. Then: is it safe to pull the boat? An hour later, yes.

timeline.text: Hey Dwight! Thats the front sway bar links, $220.26 for the pair. They keep the truck from leaning in the turns. Wont fall apart but its gonna keep clunking
No problem, Dwight. They aren't urgent, but the clunk won't go away on its own. Would you like us to do them with your next oil change?

is it safe to pull my boat with it like that
Good question, Dwight. Worn sway bar links mostly affect how the truck leans and how it sounds. I'll confirm whether towing is a concern for yours.

reads_back.operator_credit: slot 17: first answer 12.6 minutes (his ledger row is 11), three replies, two drafts discarded, one replaced before he looked and one edited, nothing resolved

truth.outcome: the recommended sway bar links are not sold; resolved by 7 silent days
facts: the price was named before the reason for the work
the customer said 'not today' once and slot 17 accepted it
the discarded draft proposed doing the work with the next oil change

why: Price, then need, then 'just holler': the three habits of his call sheet, typed.
The draft he threw away is what the lead advisor would have sent.
This is one of the days story S5 counts: the shop sells less when she is off.
new_facts: Dwight Hensley, 2013 Ford F-150: front sway bar links (220.26) recommended at east at an oil change on the Thursday of week T-12 and declined the next day.
